findings.why: "What customers say" presents one 4-star review as what customers in general say, with no "one person's experience" qualifier. The review is also over a year old (2025-07-15), so confirm it is still current for this formulation and on file.
findings.fix: Change to "What one verified buyer says about SPF 50 Sunscreen", keep the quote verbatim with its attribution, and add "Individual experience".

tone_read: Calm and low-key: one verified review with buyer, rating and date shown, and no brand hype or fear. The quote is about feel, not protection.
language_read: The quote is verbatim from REV4, and its matte, blends-in direction is consistent with the page's non-shiny and no-white-cast wording (F3, F8). There is no SPF or protection claim on the creative, so the sun-protection rules do not come into play.
